stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Jefferson is Miles's father, a police officer who pushes him hard and calls Spider-Man a menace. After Aaron's death he apologizes through Miles's dorm door, then cheers on the new Spider-Man against Kingpin without knowing it is his son.
stages.whoA: His dad, a cop who pushes him hard but believes in him.
stages.whoB: His son, secretly the new Spider-Man he comes to trust.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Now a police captain, Jeff struggles to reach a son who keeps missing family moments. Miles learns that his father's death is meant to be a canon event and runs from the Spider-Society to save him.
stages.whoA: His dad, now a captain, whose death the Society calls a canon event.
stages.whoB: His son, who keeps slipping away and secretly fights to save him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Rio is Miles's mother, a nurse who worries about him as he settles into his new boarding school.
stages.whoA: His mom, who worries about him at boarding school.
stages.whoB: Her son, who is struggling at his new school.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Rio grounds Miles for being late to his father's promotion party. Later he tries to tell her he is Spider-Man, but she cannot make sense of what he is saying.
stages.whoA: His mom, whom he nearly tells his secret.
stages.whoB: Her son, who keeps something big from her.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Jefferson and Rio are married and raise their son Miles together in Brooklyn.
stages.whoA: His wife, Miles's mother.
stages.whoB: Her husband, Miles's father.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Jefferson and Aaron are brothers who have drifted apart, and Jefferson does not like Aaron's influence on Miles. When Aaron is killed, Jefferson finds the new Spider-Man kneeling over his body and takes him for his brother's killer.
stages.whoA: His estranged brother, Miles's favorite uncle.
stages.whoB: His brother, a police officer he has drifted apart from.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Aaron is Rio's brother-in-law and the uncle her son Miles looks up to.
stages.whoA: Her brother-in-law, Miles's favorite uncle.
stages.whoB: His sister-in-law, Miles's mother.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Uncle Aaron is the relative Miles feels closest to. He takes Miles to paint graffiti in an abandoned station, where Miles is bitten by the spider.
stages.whoA: His beloved uncle, who takes him to paint graffiti.
stages.whoB: His nephew, who looks up to him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Miles discovers that Aaron is the Prowler, the masked enforcer Kingpin has sent to hunt him. On the roof of Aunt May's house Miles unmasks, and Aaron cannot bring himself to kill his nephew. Kingpin shoots him, and he dies in Miles's arms.
stages.whoA: His uncle, secretly the Prowler, who dies sparing him.
stages.whoB: His nephew, the new Spider-Man he will not kill.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Aaron secretly works for Wilson Fisk as the Prowler, his silent masked enforcer. He fights Spider-Man at the collider and hunts Miles on Fisk's orders, but when he refuses to kill the boy, Fisk shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: The Prowler, his enforcer, whom he shoots for sparing Miles.
stages.whoB: His boss, who shoots him for sparing Miles.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: May is Peter's aunt. After he is killed, she mourns him and opens his hidden base to the Spider-People.
stages.whoA: His Aunt May.
stages.whoB: Her nephew, whose death she mourns.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Mary Jane is Peter's wife. After Kingpin kills him, she gives the eulogy at his funeral and tells the city that everyone can carry on his work.
stages.whoA: His wife, Mary Jane.
stages.whoB: Her husband, killed by Kingpin. She gives his eulogy.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Peter saves Miles at the collider, senses he has the same powers, and promises to train him. Badly hurt, he hands Miles the drive to stop the machine, and Kingpin kills him in front of the boy.
stages.whoA: A new spider kid he promises to train.
stages.whoB: His world's Spider-Man, who dies after trusting him with the drive.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Wilson Fisk blames Spider-Man for the deaths of his wife and son. When Peter tries to stop his collider, Fisk kills him while he lies trapped and hurt.
stages.whoA: Kingpin, who kills him at the collider.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whom he blames for his family's deaths and kills.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: The Green Goblin fights Spider-Man at Kingpin's collider and shoves him into it, leaving him badly hurt. The Goblin dies in the blast.
stages.whoA: The Green Goblin, who wrecks him at the collider.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, his enemy at the collider.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: The Green Goblin is one of Fisk's enforcers and fights Spider-Man to protect the collider.
stages.whoA: One of his enforcers.
stages.whoB: His boss, Kingpin.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Olivia Octavius runs Alchemax and builds Fisk's collider as his head scientist. When the Spider-People get in the way, she assures him he will still get his family back.
stages.whoA: His head scientist, who builds his collider.
stages.whoB: Her boss, whose collider she builds.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Tombstone is one of Fisk's heavies and fights the Spider-People on his orders.
stages.whoA: One of his heavies.
stages.whoB: His boss, Kingpin.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Scorpion is one of Fisk's enforcers and attacks the Spider-People on his orders, until he is arrested with the rest of the crew.
stages.whoA: One of his enforcers.
stages.whoB: His boss, Kingpin.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Miles watches Wilson Fisk kill Spider-Man, and Fisk sends his enforcers after him. In the end Miles stuns Fisk, wrecks the collider and leaves him webbed up for the police.
stages.whoA: Kingpin, who killed Spider-Man and his uncle.
stages.whoB: The new Spider-Man, who wrecks his collider.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Fisk shoots Jefferson's brother Aaron dead. At the collider, Jefferson sees Fisk beating the new Spider-Man and urges the hero on. Fisk is arrested, and Jefferson receives proof that he killed Aaron.
stages.whoA: A police officer whose brother he killed.
stages.whoB: The crime lord who killed his brother.

stages.whoB: Kingpin, whose collider dragged him into this world.

stages.whoB: Doc Ock, who catches him at Alchemax.

stages.text: Mary Jane is Peter B.'s wife, but they have split up after he balked at starting a family. He still misses her, and after Miles sends him home he goes to see her.
stages.whoA: His estranged wife, MJ, whom he still loves.
stages.whoB: Her estranged husband, Peter.

stages.text: Peter B. and MJ are back together and have a baby daughter, Mayday.
stages.whoA: His wife, and mother of their daughter Mayday.

stages.text: Pulled into Miles's world, a jaded Peter B. Parker reluctantly agrees to train him. He teaches Miles to swing but keeps him out of the final plan, until Miles proves himself and sends Peter home.
stages.whoA: The kid he reluctantly trains, who becomes a real Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: A jaded older Spider-Man who trains him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Peter B. welcomes Miles to the Spider-Society and introduces him to his baby daughter, but like Gwen he has kept the truth about Miles from him. After Miles flees the Society, Peter B. joins Gwen's team to bring him home.
stages.whoA: His old student, whom he sets out to rescue.
stages.whoB: His old mentor, now a dad, who joins the rescue.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Gwen saves Peter B. and Miles from Doc Ock, and the three head to Aunt May's house. They fight Kingpin side by side before going home.
stages.whoA: Spider-Woman from another world, his teammate.
stages.whoB: An older Spider-Man, her teammate.

stages.text: Both now belong to the Spider-Society. After Miguel exiles Gwen, Peter B. joins the team she gathers to rescue Miles.

stages.whoB: A fellow Society member who joins her rescue team.

stages.whoB: Peter B. Parker, a fellow stranded Spider-Man.

stages.text: May is the aunt of this world's late Peter, and Peter B.'s own Aunt May has died. Meeting is hard for both of them, but she takes him in and leads him to her nephew's hidden base.
stages.whoA: This world's Aunt May, a painful echo of his own.
stages.whoB: Another version of her late nephew.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: May shelters Miles and the other Spider-People in her late nephew's base. When Miles is ready, she gives him web-shooters and one of Peter's old suits, which he makes his own.
stages.whoA: Peter's Aunt May, who gives him web-shooters and a suit.
stages.whoB: The new Spider-Man, whom she helps suit up.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Gwen, a Spider-Woman pulled in from another world, poses as a student at Miles's school and becomes his close friend. They fight Kingpin together, and after going home she finds a way to reach him.
stages.whoA: Spider-Woman from another world, his close friend.
stages.whoB: The new Spider-Man, her close friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Gwen visits Miles and they reconnect, but she keeps from him what the Spider-Society knows about him. When the truth comes out he feels betrayed. She stands up for him to Miguel, is sent home, and gathers a team to bring him back.
stages.whoA: His closest friend, who kept the truth from him.
stages.whoB: Her closest friend, whom she sets out to rescue.

stages.text: After helping Miles escape Miguel's world, Margo joins the team Gwen gathers to bring him home.
stages.whoA: Spider-Byte, part of her team to rescue Miles.
stages.whoB: Gwen, who gathers the team to rescue Miles.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Gwen tracks the Spot across universes and fights him in Mumbattan.
stages.whoA: The Spot, a villain she tracks across universes.
stages.whoB: Spider-Woman, who tracks him down.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Gwen first meets Jeff and Rio, awkwardly, at the party for Jeff's promotion. After Miles goes missing, she reveals herself to them, tells them it is her fault and not theirs, and promises to bring their son home.
stages.whoA: Miles's dad, whom she promises to bring Miles home.
stages.whoB: Miles's friend Gwen, who promises to bring him home.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Gwen first meets Jeff and Rio, awkwardly, at the party for Jeff's promotion. After Miles goes missing, she reveals herself to them, tells them it is her fault and not theirs, and promises to bring their son home.
stages.whoA: Miles's mom, whom she promises to bring Miles home.
stages.whoB: Miles's friend Gwen, who promises to bring him home.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: While escaping Alchemax, Miles knocks down one of its scientists with a thrown bagel.
stages.whoA: An Alchemax scientist he knocks down with a bagel.
stages.whoB: The kid who knocked him down with a bagel.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: The collider's destruction left Jonathan Ohnn covered in portals, and as the Spot he blames Miles for ruining his life and wants to be his great villain. He grows strong enough to threaten Miles's whole world.
stages.whoA: The Spot, a villain who blames him for his ruined life.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the nemesis he blames for everything.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: The Spot's raid on Alchemax brings disaster to Mumbattan, and Pavitr fights him with Miles, Gwen and Hobie.
stages.whoA: Mumbattan's Spider-Man, who fights him.
stages.whoB: The Spot, who brings disaster to his city.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Hobie fights the Spot in Mumbattan beside Miles, Gwen and Pavitr.
stages.whoA: Spider-Punk, who fights him in Mumbattan.
stages.whoB: The Spot, whom he fights in Mumbattan.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Miles and Gwen team up with Pavitr, Mumbattan's cheerful Spider-Man, against the Spot. Pavitr later joins Gwen's team to bring Miles home.
stages.whoA: Pavitr, Mumbattan's Spider-Man and a cheerful new friend.
stages.whoB: Miles, a Spider-Man from Brooklyn and his new friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Hobie fights the Spot beside Miles in Mumbattan. When Miguel locks Miles in a cage, Hobie teaches him how to break out, then quits the Society and later joins the team coming to save him.
stages.whoA: Spider-Punk, who helps him break free of the Society.
stages.whoB: Miles, a Spider-Man he helps escape Miguel.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Miguel O'Hara leads the Spider-Society and has no patience for Miles. He tells Miles his father's death is a canon event that must happen, and when Miles refuses, Miguel locks him up and hunts him down.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man 2099, who wants him to let his father die.
stages.whoB: A Spider-Man he says was never meant to be one.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Margo meets Miles at the Spider-Society's base, and they hit it off. When he sneaks into the Go Home Machine, she could shut it down but lets him go, then joins Gwen's team to bring him home.
stages.whoA: Spider-Byte, who lets him escape through the Go Home Machine.
stages.whoB: Miles, whom she lets slip away home.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Jess Drew brings Miles and Gwen in to answer to Miguel after the disaster in Mumbattan. When Miles runs, she chases him on her motorcycle and slams into him.
stages.whoA: Jess Drew, the Society officer who hunts him down.
stages.whoB: The runaway Spider-Man she chases.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: The Scarlet Spider is one of Miguel's top lieutenants in the Spider-Society, alongside Jess Drew. After Miles escapes, Miguel takes him and Jess to Miles's world to hunt him down.
stages.whoA: The Scarlet Spider, one of his top lieutenants.
stages.whoB: Miguel, the Society leader he serves.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Web-Slinger introduces himself to Miles at the Spider-Society's base, and Miles asks why his horse wears a mask. In the chase he catches up to Miles and challenges him to a draw, but Miles webs first and briefly takes his horse.
stages.whoA: Web-Slinger, a cowboy Spider-Man who challenges him to a draw.
stages.whoB: The runaway Spider-Man he tries to outdraw.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: This Peter Parker is a member of the Spider-Society. He urges Miles to accept the truth about canon events, then joins the chase to stop him going home.
stages.whoA: A Society Spider-Man who urges him to let go.
stages.whoB: The runaway Spider-Man he tries to stop.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Miles saves Inspector Singh as Mumbattan's collider collapses, not knowing Singh's death was meant to be a canon event.
stages.whoA: A police inspector he saves, breaking a canon event.
stages.whoB: The Spider-Man who saves his life.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: On Earth-42, Miles meets another Miles Morales who is that world's Prowler. With his Uncle Aaron, the Prowler holds the Miles from Earth-1610 captive.
stages.whoA: Another Miles Morales, the Prowler of Earth-42, who captures him.
stages.whoB: The Miles from another world whom he holds captive.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: On Earth-42, Miles finds a living Uncle Aaron, who restrains him and holds him captive with that world's Prowler.
stages.whoA: Earth-42's Uncle Aaron, alive and holding him captive.
stages.whoB: A Miles from another world, whom he holds captive.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Aaron is the uncle of Earth-42's Miles, who has become the Prowler. Together they hold the Miles from Earth-1610 captive.
stages.whoA: His nephew, the Prowler.
stages.whoB: His uncle, Aaron.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Lyla is Miguel's AI assistant. She tells him the multiverse has held together and gives him a device for crossing universes.
stages.whoA: Lyla, his AI assistant.
stages.whoB: Her boss, Spider-Man 2099.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Lyla runs the data for Miguel's Spider-Society and tracks Miles for him.
stages.whoA: Lyla, his AI assistant who runs the Society's data.
stages.whoB: Her boss, Spider-Man 2099.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Miguel travels to Earth-67 to explain the multiverse to its Spider-Man. Instead the two get stuck arguing and pointing at each other.
stages.whoA: Earth-67's Spider-Man, who ends up arguing with him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man 2099, a visitor he ends up arguing with.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Jess Drew is Miguel's right hand in the Spider-Society. They catch the Vulture together and ride out to stop Miles.
stages.whoA: Jess Drew, his second in command.
stages.whoB: Miguel, her leader in the Spider-Society.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Hobie belongs to Miguel's Spider-Society, though he has no love for its rules.
stages.whoA: Spider-Punk, a member of his Society.
stages.whoB: Miguel, leader of the Spider-Society.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: When Miguel locks Miles in a cage, Hobie teaches him how to break out and quits the Society. He later builds his own portal watches from parts taken from Miguel's lab.
stages.whoA: Spider-Punk, who frees Miles and quits his Society.
stages.whoB: Miguel, the leader he defies and walks out on.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Margo is a member of Miguel's Spider-Society. When Miles sneaks into the Go Home Machine, she lets him go instead of shutting it down, then joins Gwen's team.
stages.whoA: Spider-Byte, a member of his Society.
stages.whoB: Miguel, leader of the Spider-Society.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Miguel recruits Peter B. into his Spider-Society. After Miles flees Miguel, Peter B. joins Gwen's team to bring him home.
stages.whoA: A Society member he recruited, who later joins Gwen's rescue.
stages.whoB: Miguel, leader of the Spider-Society.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Gayatri is Pavitr's girlfriend in Mumbattan. She is caught up in the Spot's attack on the city.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend, Gayatri.
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend, Pavitr.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Inspector Singh is Gayatri's father, a police inspector in Mumbattan.
stages.whoA: Her father, a police inspector.
stages.whoB: His daughter, Gayatri.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Pavitr and Hobie fight the Spot together in Mumbattan, and both later join Gwen's team to save Miles.
stages.whoA: Spider-Punk, who fights beside him.
stages.whoB: Pavitr, who fights beside him.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: May is Peter's aunt, who raised him after his parents died. She struggles with the bills, survives a heart attack during the Sinister Six's rampage, and urges him to be honest with Gwen and Liz.
stages.whoA: His Aunt May, who raised him.
stages.whoB: Her nephew, whom she raised.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Ben is Peter's uncle, who raised him with May. He is shot dead by a burglar Peter let escape, and his words about great power and great responsibility drive Peter to be Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: His late Uncle Ben, killed by a burglar he let go.
stages.whoB: His nephew, whom he raised.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Ben and May are married and raise their nephew Peter together, until a burglar kills Ben.
stages.whoA: Her late husband, Ben.
stages.whoB: His wife, May.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Walter Hardy is the burglar who breaks into the Parker home. When Ben moves to protect May, Walter shoots him dead and flees in Ben's car.
stages.whoA: The burglar who kills him.
stages.whoB: The man he shoots in the Parkers' home.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: A burglar Peter lets escape goes on to kill Uncle Ben. Peter catches him but spares his life and leaves him for the police.
stages.whoA: The burglar he let go, who killed Uncle Ben.
stages.whoB: The young hero who caught him.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: During the Vault breakout, inmate Walter Hardy helps Spider-Man, and Peter learns he is Black Cat's father and Ben's killer. Walter chooses to stay in prison.
stages.whoA: Black Cat's father, and Uncle Ben's killer.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who will never forgive him for killing Ben.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Walter Hardy is Black Cat's father, a burglar in prison. She sneaks into the Vault to free him, but he chooses to stay and pay his debt.
stages.whoA: Her imprisoned father.
stages.whoB: His daughter, the thief Black Cat.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Black Cat first clashes with Spider-Man when she tries to steal the symbiote. They then team up against the Chameleon, and she flirts with him the whole way.
stages.whoA: Black Cat, a flirtatious thief who sometimes helps him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whom she flirts with and works beside.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Black Cat helps Spider-Man contain the Vault breakout while trying to free her father. When Walter chooses to stay in prison, she blames Spider-Man and storms off.
stages.whoA: Black Cat, who blames him for her father staying locked up.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whom she blames for keeping her father in prison.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Gwen is Peter's best friend and fellow intern in Dr. Connors's lab, and she has quietly loved him for years. After Venom targets her, she kisses him, and he realizes he feels the same.
stages.whoA: His best friend, who quietly loves him.
stages.whoB: Her best friend, whom she has loved for years.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Peter starts dating Liz and Gwen dates Harry, but they finally admit their feelings. When Harry tells her she is all that keeps him off the Green, Gwen stays with him, and Peter accepts it.
stages.whoA: His best friend and true love, still with Harry.
stages.whoB: Her best friend and true love.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Harry is Peter's best friend, neglected by his father Norman. He secretly takes an Oscorp formula, and Spider-Man finds him taking off the Green Goblin's mask. Harry then leaves for Europe to recover.
stages.whoA: His best friend, Norman Osborn's neglected son.
stages.whoB: His best friend, Peter.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Back from Europe, Harry dates Gwen and helps Spider-Man find the true Goblin, his father. He blames Spider-Man for Norman's apparent death and leans on Gwen to keep her.
stages.whoA: His best friend, now dating Gwen.
stages.whoB: His best friend, who also loves Gwen.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Mary Jane, Anna Watson's niece, goes to the Fall Formal as Peter's date, then transfers to Midtown High and becomes part of his circle of friends.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane, his Fall Formal date and friend.
stages.whoB: Peter, her Fall Formal date and friend.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Mary Jane becomes Gwen's friend and urges her to tell Peter how she feels. She helps catch Gwen when she falls from a parade balloon, and later gives her a makeover.
stages.whoA: Mary Jane, a friend who urges her to step up.
stages.whoB: Gwen, a friend she pushes to tell Peter how she feels.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Liz, a popular cheerleader, warms to Peter as he tutors her, and her relationship with Flash ends.
stages.whoA: Liz, a cheerleader he tutors.
stages.whoB: Peter, her tutor, whom she starts to like.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Liz and Peter start dating at New Year's. He tries to help her brother Mark, but he breaks up with her to be with Gwen.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend Liz, until he leaves her for Gwen.
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend, until he breaks up with her for Gwen.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Mark Allan is Liz's older brother. Deep in gambling debt, he agrees to an experiment that turns him into the Molten Man.
stages.whoA: Her brother, Mark.
stages.whoB: His sister, Liz.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Mark is the brother of Peter's girlfriend Liz. As the Molten Man he fights Spider-Man, who tries to help him, until he is beaten and locked in the Vault.
stages.whoA: Liz's brother, the Molten Man.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who fights him and tries to help him.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Green Goblin has Mark turned into the Molten Man and controls his powers in secret. He forces Mark to fight Spider-Man by promising to make him normal again.
stages.whoA: A pawn he turns into the Molten Man.
stages.whoB: The Goblin, who made him the Molten Man and controls him.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Sally Avril, a snobbish cheerleader, harshly turns Peter down and is stunned when he brings Mary Jane to the Fall Formal.
stages.whoA: Sally, a cheerleader who shoots him down.
stages.whoB: Peter, a classmate she looks down on.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Stuck on a police ride-along with Peter, Sally slowly warms up to him.
stages.whoA: Sally, who warms to him on a ride-along.
stages.whoB: Peter, whom she slowly warms up to.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Dr. Curt Connors takes Peter and Gwen on as interns in his lab at Empire State University. When his lizard serum turns him into the Lizard, Spider-Man fights him and cures him with an antidote. Later Miles Warren blackmails Connors over his Lizard past, and he leaves town.
stages.whoA: Dr. Connors, his lab mentor, who once turned into the Lizard.
stages.whoB: Peter, his high school intern.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Connors takes Gwen on as an intern in his lab alongside Peter. When he becomes the Lizard, she helps work on the cure.
stages.whoA: Dr. Connors, her lab mentor.
stages.whoB: Gwen, one of his interns.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Martha is Curt's wife and a scientist herself, and they have a son, Billy. When Curt becomes the Lizard, she helps make the cure that turns him human again. Later the family leaves New York together to escape Miles Warren's blackmail.
stages.whoA: His wife, Martha, a fellow scientist.
stages.whoB: Her husband, Curt.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Eddie Brock is a freshman at Empire State University and the lab assistant in the Connors lab, where the symbiote is kept.
stages.whoA: Eddie, his lab assistant.
stages.whoB: Dr. Connors, who runs the lab he works in.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Max Dillon is an electrician and a friend of Curt's, called in to work on his lab. An accident there turns him into living electricity, and when no cure comes, he storms the lab to force Connors to make one.
stages.whoA: Max Dillon, a friend hurt in an accident in his lab.
stages.whoB: Dr. Connors, the friend he wants a cure from.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Martha runs the lab where Peter interns, and she fires him when he sells photos of the Lizard to the Bugle. Later she laughs off the idea that he is Spider-Man but starts to wonder, and she warns him and Gwen about Miles Warren.
stages.whoA: Peter, an intern in the lab she runs.
stages.whoB: Dr. Martha Connors, who runs the lab where he interns.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Gwen interns in the lab Martha runs with her husband. When Curt becomes the Lizard, Gwen helps Martha and the others make the cure, and later Martha warns her and Peter about Miles Warren.
stages.whoA: Gwen, an intern in her lab.
stages.whoB: Dr. Martha Connors, who runs her lab with Curt.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Eddie and Peter grew up like brothers after their parents died in the same plane crash. Eddie, now the lab assistant in Connors's lab, starts to resent Peter for never being there.
stages.whoA: Eddie Brock, a big brother to him since childhood.
stages.whoB: Peter, the little brother he grew up with.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: When Peter casts off the symbiote, it bonds to the vengeful Eddie, who becomes Venom. He goes after everyone Peter loves until Spider-Man strips the symbiote away, and Eddie is sent to Ravencroft.
stages.whoA: Venom, his old friend turned enemy.
stages.whoB: Peter, the brother he wants to destroy.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: As Venom, Eddie goes after the people Peter loves, and he targets Aunt May.
stages.whoA: Peter's aunt, whom he targets.
stages.whoB: Venom, who targets her to hurt Peter.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Eddie is a longtime friend who works with Gwen in Connors's lab and offers to take her to the Fall Formal.
stages.whoA: Gwen, a longtime friend from the lab.
stages.whoB: Eddie, a longtime friend from the lab.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: As Venom, Eddie ties Gwen to a balloon at the Thanksgiving Day parade to hurt Peter.
stages.whoA: Gwen, whom he uses to hurt Peter.
stages.whoB: Venom, who ties her to a parade balloon.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: The Spider-Society's records of canon events include Captain Stacy dying in this Spider-Man's arms.
stages.whoA: Captain Stacy, Gwen's father, who dies in his arms.
stages.whoB: The Spider-Man in whose arms he dies.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Captain Stacy is Gwen's father and believes Spider-Man is a hero. He shares Thanksgiving dinner with Peter and May, and he seems to know Peter's secret.
stages.whoA: Captain Stacy, Gwen's dad, who seems to know his secret.
stages.whoB: His daughter's friend Peter, whom he seems to know is Spider-Man.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: George Stacy is Gwen's father, a police captain. The Master Planner has her kidnapped to force him to hand over his security clearance.
stages.whoA: Her dad, a police captain.
stages.whoB: His daughter, Gwen.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: As the Master Planner, Doctor Octopus has Electro and the Vulture kidnap Gwen to blackmail her father, until Spider-Man rescues her.
stages.whoA: Captain Stacy's daughter, whom he has kidnapped.
stages.whoB: The Master Planner, who has her kidnapped.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Master Planner kidnaps Captain Stacy's daughter to force him to hand over his security clearance.
stages.whoA: A police captain he blackmails.
stages.whoB: The Master Planner, who kidnaps his daughter.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Electro and the Vulture kidnap Gwen for the Master Planner, and Spider-Man comes to her rescue.
stages.whoA: Electro, who kidnaps her.
stages.whoB: Gwen, whom he kidnaps for the Master Planner.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Vulture and Electro kidnap Gwen for the Master Planner, and Spider-Man comes to her rescue.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, who kidnaps her.
stages.whoB: Gwen, whom he kidnaps for the Master Planner.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Harry and Gwen are both Peter's best friends. Gwen is the only one who notices Harry taking a dangerous formula and wants him to quit.
stages.whoA: Gwen, a close friend who wants him off the Green.
stages.whoB: Harry, a close friend she worries about.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Back from Europe, Harry asks Gwen out and they become a couple. When she plans to leave him for Peter, he tells her she is all that keeps him from the Green.
stages.whoA: His girlfriend Gwen, who loves Peter.
stages.whoB: Her boyfriend Harry, whom she cannot bring herself to leave.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Norman is Harry's cold, demanding father, who favors Peter over his own son. Desperate to impress him, Harry takes an Oscorp formula and becomes a Green Goblin.
stages.whoA: His cold, demanding father.
stages.whoB: His son, whom he sees as a failure.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Norman, the true Green Goblin, framed Harry for his crimes. Harry exposes the Chameleon posing as his father, and Norman fakes his own death.
stages.whoA: His father, the real Goblin who framed him.
stages.whoB: His son, whom he framed for the Goblin's crimes.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Norman is Harry's cold, ruthless father, and Spider-Man saves him from the Vulture. Meanwhile a masked Green Goblin torments Spider-Man and plays New York's crime bosses against each other.
stages.whoA: Harry's cold father, whom he saves from the Vulture.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, the hero he torments as the Goblin.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Norman takes Peter on as his protege and favors him over his own son.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, Harry's father, now his mentor.
stages.whoB: Peter, his son's friend and his protege.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Spider-Man unmasks the Green Goblin as Norman himself, who framed Harry for his crimes. Norman seems to die in their final fight, but he slips away under a new name.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, his mentor, unmasked as the Goblin.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who unmasks him.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Otto Octavius is a timid Oscorp scientist whom Norman bullies. On Norman's orders he runs the experiments that create the Sandman and the Rhino.
stages.whoA: His timid scientist, whom he bullies.
stages.whoB: His abusive boss.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: After a lab accident fuses Otto to his metal arms, he attacks Norman and declares himself Doctor Octopus.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus, his former scientist turned enemy.
stages.whoB: His old boss, whom he attacks.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Adrian Toomes accuses Norman of stealing his flight tech and, as the Vulture, tries to drop him to his death until Spider-Man saves him.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, an inventor whose work he stole.
stages.whoB: Norman, who stole his flight tech.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: When Toomes storms into Oscorp, he first blames Otto for stealing his work, then forgives him. Later the Vulture joins Otto's Sinister Six and becomes his right hand.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, his right hand in the Sinister Six.
stages.whoB: Doctor Octopus, the leader he serves.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Doctor Octopus writes to Electro at Ravencroft, promising a cure if he breaks the villains out of prison to form the Sinister Six. Later Electro serves the Master Planner and helps kidnap Gwen.
stages.whoA: Electro, a member of his Sinister Six.
stages.whoB: Doctor Octopus, his leader in the Sinister Six.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Otto runs the experiment that turns Flint Marko into the Sandman, then brings him into the Sinister Six.
stages.whoA: The Sandman, whom he created and recruits.
stages.whoB: Doctor Octopus, who made him and leads him.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Otto bonds Alex O'Hirn to the rhino armor he designed, then brings him into the Sinister Six.
stages.whoA: The Rhino, whom he armored and recruits.
stages.whoB: Doctor Octopus, who armored him and leads him.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Montana joins the first Sinister Six, which Doctor Octopus forms to destroy Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: The Shocker, a member of his Sinister Six.
stages.whoB: Doctor Octopus, his leader in the Sinister Six.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Mysterio joins the Sinister Six that the Master Planner re-forms at Christmas.
stages.whoA: Mysterio, a member of his new Sinister Six.
stages.whoB: The Master Planner, his leader in the Sinister Six.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kraven joins the Sinister Six that the Master Planner re-forms at Christmas.
stages.whoA: Kraven, a member of his new Sinister Six.
stages.whoB: The Master Planner, his leader in the Sinister Six.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Tinkerer is the Master Planner's second in command and tech support, and he builds the gear for the new Sinister Six.
stages.whoA: The Tinkerer, who gears up his Sinister Six.
stages.whoB: The Master Planner, whose team he equips.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Doctor Octopus forms the Sinister Six to kill Spider-Man and later, as the Master Planner, plots against him from a hidden lair. Spider-Man subdues him in the Valentine's Day gang war, and he is arrested.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, the hero he builds the Sinister Six to kill.
stages.whoB: Doctor Octopus, mastermind of the Sinister Six.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Tombstone and the Master Planner fight for control of New York. At a Valentine's Day summit their talks collapse into open gang war.
stages.whoA: The Master Planner, a rival for control of the city.
stages.whoB: Tombstone, a rival for control of the city.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Tombstone and Silvermane fight for control of New York. At a Valentine's Day summit their talks collapse into open gang war.
stages.whoA: Silvermane, a rival crime boss.
stages.whoB: Tombstone, a rival crime boss.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Silvermane and the Master Planner fight for control of New York. At a Valentine's Day summit their talks collapse into open gang war.
stages.whoA: The Master Planner, a rival crime boss.
stages.whoB: Silvermane, a rival crime boss.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Hammerhead is the Big Man's enforcer and his go-between with the city's villains. After Hammerhead betrays him at the Valentine's Day summit, Tombstone fires him.
stages.whoA: Hammerhead, his enforcer, until he betrays him.
stages.whoB: The Big Man, his boss, until he betrays him.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Montana works for the Big Man, who has him use a stolen vibration suit to become the Shocker. Later the Big Man arms Montana's new Enforcers.
stages.whoA: Montana, his hired muscle, the Shocker.
stages.whoB: The Big Man, his employer.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Big Man sends the Enforcers after Spider-Man, then offers to pay him to look the other way, which Spider-Man refuses. In the end Spider-Man exposes him as the Big Man and gets him arrested.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, the hero who exposes him.
stages.whoB: Tombstone, the Big Man of crime he refuses to work for.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Through Hammerhead, Norman makes a deal with the Big Man to create super villains who keep Spider-Man busy.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, who builds villains for him.
stages.whoB: The Big Man, who pays him to make villains.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: As the Green Goblin, Norman tries to overthrow Tombstone and secretly sets up the summit that brings him down. Then the Goblin takes over as the new Big Man.
stages.whoA: The Goblin, who brings him down and takes his place.
stages.whoB: Tombstone, the crime boss he overthrows.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Tinkerer builds new suits for the Big Man's Enforcers.
stages.whoA: The Tinkerer, who equips his Enforcers.
stages.whoB: The Big Man, whose Enforcers he equips.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Hammerhead brokers the Big Man's deals with Norman and later accuses him of being the Goblin. The Goblin kidnaps him and dangles him over molten metal, and later secretly steers him into betraying Tombstone.
stages.whoA: Hammerhead, a thug he kidnaps and later manipulates.
stages.whoB: The Goblin, who kidnaps him and secretly plays him.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Norman hires the Chameleon to pose as him and throw Spider-Man off the Goblin's trail, until Harry unmasks the impostor.
stages.whoA: The Chameleon, whom he hires to pose as himself.
stages.whoB: Norman, who hires him to play his double.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Harry unmasks the Chameleon, who has been posing as his father, because the real Norman never apologizes.
stages.whoA: The Chameleon, who posed as his father.
stages.whoB: Harry, who sees through his disguise.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Green Goblin sabotages the Vault's security during Black Cat's attempt to free her father, and she ends up fighting him.
stages.whoA: Black Cat, a thief who fights him at the Vault.
stages.whoB: The Green Goblin, whom she fights at the Vault.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Black Cat teams with Spider-Man against the Chameleon's crime spree, though mostly to get a valuable diamond for herself.
stages.whoA: Black Cat, who helps foil his crime spree.
stages.whoB: The Chameleon, whose crime spree she foils.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Chameleon impersonates Spider-Man to frame him for crimes, then slips out of police custody in disguise. Later he poses as Norman Osborn to throw Spider-Man off the Goblin's trail.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, whose face he steals.
stages.whoB: The Chameleon, who frames him.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Quentin Beck uses his effects skills to help the Chameleon frame Spider-Man, until Black Cat knocks him out.
stages.whoA: Quentin Beck, who helps frame Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: The Chameleon, whom he helps frame Spider-Man.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Phineas Mason builds gadgets to help the Chameleon frame Spider-Man, until Black Cat knocks him out.
stages.whoA: Phineas Mason, who helps frame Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: The Chameleon, whom he helps frame Spider-Man.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Mysterio and the Tinkerer both work on the Chameleon's scheme to frame Spider-Man, and both end up arrested.
stages.whoA: Phineas Mason, a partner in the frame job.
stages.whoB: Quentin Beck, a partner in the frame job.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Black Cat knocks Mysterio out while helping Spider-Man stop the Chameleon's crime spree.
stages.whoA: Mysterio, whom she knocks out.
stages.whoB: Black Cat, who knocks him out.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Black Cat knocks the Tinkerer out while helping Spider-Man stop the Chameleon's crime spree.
stages.whoA: The Tinkerer, whom she knocks out.
stages.whoB: Black Cat, who knocks him out.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Quentin Beck helps frame Spider-Man and is arrested. Later he attacks again, but each Mysterio Spider-Man catches turns out to be a robot decoy.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, whom he haunts with tricks and decoys.
stages.whoB: Mysterio, a master of illusions he never quite catches.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Phineas Mason helps the Chameleon frame Spider-Man, then as the Tinkerer arms the Sinister Six and the Enforcers against him.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, the hero his gadgets are built to beat.
stages.whoB: The Tinkerer, who arms his enemies.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: After the Sinister Six's Christmas attack, the Tinkerer helps the Vulture escape the police.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, whom he helps escape the police.
stages.whoB: The Tinkerer, who helps him escape the police.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: After the Sinister Six's Christmas attack, the Tinkerer helps Electro escape the police.
stages.whoA: Electro, whom he helps escape the police.
stages.whoB: The Tinkerer, who helps him escape the police.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: After the Sinister Six's Christmas attack, the Tinkerer helps the Sandman escape the police.
stages.whoA: The Sandman, whom he helps escape the police.
stages.whoB: The Tinkerer, who helps him escape the police.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: After the Sinister Six's Christmas attack, the Tinkerer helps Kraven escape the police.
stages.whoA: Kraven, whom he helps escape the police.
stages.whoB: The Tinkerer, who helps him escape the police.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: The Vulture is the first super villain Spider-Man fights, while Toomes is trying to kill Norman Osborn. He returns in both Sinister Six teams and serves as Doctor Octopus's right hand.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who keeps stopping him.
stages.whoB: The Vulture, his first super villain.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Peter first mistakes the newly charged Max Dillon for a thug and fights him. Electro returns again and again, until Spider-Man captures him and he ends up at Ravencroft.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, his old foe.
stages.whoB: Electro, a living power surge he keeps fighting.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Flint Marko is a crook Spider-Man keeps arresting, until an experiment turns him into the Sandman. He fights Spider-Man with both Sinister Six teams, then saves a tanker crew and slips away.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who keeps putting him away.
stages.whoB: The Sandman, a crook he keeps arresting.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Alex O'Hirn is a thug Spider-Man keeps arresting, until he is bonded to a rhino suit. Later he helps Spider-Man wreck the plans for a Rhino army, then turns on him and is jailed.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who keeps putting him away.
stages.whoB: The Rhino, a thug he keeps arresting.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Montana fights Spider-Man as the Shocker and nearly crushes him in a garbage compactor. Later he leads the new Enforcers until Spider-Man locks them in the Vault.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who beats him again and again.
stages.whoB: The Shocker, leader of the Enforcers.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Kraven the Hunter comes to New York to make Spider-Man his prey, then joins the Master Planner's Sinister Six.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, the prey he hunts.
stages.whoB: Kraven, a hunter who makes him his prey.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Calypso Ezili is Kraven's partner and lover, at his side when he comes to New York to hunt Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Calypso, his partner and lover.
stages.whoB: Kraven, her partner and lover.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Hammerhead enforces for the Big Man and fights Spider-Man again and again. At the Valentine's Day summit, his betrayal sparks a gang war Spider-Man has to stop.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, a constant thorn for the Big Man.
stages.whoB: Hammerhead, the Big Man's enforcer.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Silvermane, an old crime boss, battles for control of New York. At the Valentine's Day summit, Spider-Man disables his hydraulic armor and the police take him.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who disables his armor.
stages.whoB: Silvermane, an old crime boss he takes down.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Silver Sable is Silvermane's daughter and enforcer.
stages.whoA: His daughter and enforcer.
stages.whoB: Her father, an old crime boss.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Silver Sable chases the specs for a Rhino army, and Spider-Man and the Rhino beat her before she gets away.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who beats her.
stages.whoB: Silver Sable, Silvermane's daughter.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Silver Sable and the Rhino fight over the specs for a Rhino army, and he and Spider-Man beat her.
stages.whoA: The Rhino, who helps beat her.
stages.whoB: Silver Sable, a rival for the Rhino specs.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: J. Jonah Jameson runs the Daily Bugle and smears Spider-Man, while buying Peter's photos of him. He dismisses Venom's claim that Peter is Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Peter, the kid who sells him Spider-Man photos.
stages.whoB: His boss at the Bugle, who hates Spider-Man.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Robbie Robertson is editor in chief of the Bugle, where Peter sells his photos, and one of the few there who sees Spider-Man as a hero.
stages.whoA: Peter, a young photographer at his paper.
stages.whoB: Robbie, the Bugle's fair minded editor.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Robbie is Jameson's editor in chief. He stays fair to Spider-Man while Jameson rants, and quietly backs Ned's Spider-Man story over Jameson's doubts.
stages.whoA: His level headed editor in chief.
stages.whoB: His hot headed publisher.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Robbie backs Ned Lee's hunch about Spider-Man's identity and tells him to run with the story.
stages.whoA: Ned, a young reporter he backs.
stages.whoB: Robbie, his editor, who backs his story.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Betty Brant is Jameson's secretary and stays calm through his outbursts.
stages.whoA: Betty, his unflappable secretary.
stages.whoB: Her boss, who is always shouting.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Ned Lee is a young reporter at Jameson's Bugle. Jameson cuts in when Ned asks Betty out.
stages.whoA: Ned, a young reporter at his paper.
stages.whoB: His blustering publisher.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Betty Brant is the Bugle secretary who drags Peter back into the office to collect his pay. Peter has a crush on her and keeps asking her to the Fall Formal, but she turns him down as too young for her.
stages.whoA: Peter, a young photographer with a crush on her.
stages.whoB: Betty, the Bugle secretary he has a crush on.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Ned asks Betty out while digging for clues about whether Peter is Spider-Man, until Jameson cuts in.
stages.whoA: Betty, the Bugle secretary he asks out.
stages.whoB: Ned, the reporter who asks her out.

stages.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man
stages.text: Ned Lee is a young reporter at the Bugle, where Peter sells his photos. After Venom claims Peter is Spider-Man, Ned interviews Peter's friends and Spider-Man's foes, and decides Peter cannot be Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Peter, a Bugle photographer he suspects is Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: Ned Lee, a Bugle reporter digging into his secret.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: May is Peter's widowed aunt, who works hard to pay the bills, and Peter keeps his Oscorp internship partly to help her. When he breaks down, she wishes his Uncle Ben were still there.
stages.whoA: His widowed Aunt May.
stages.whoB: Her nephew, Peter.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Richard Parker is Peter's father, held in prison. Aunt May visits him there.
stages.whoA: His father, in prison.
stages.whoB: His son, Peter.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Richard is May's brother-in-law, the brother of her late husband Ben. She visits him in prison and they talk.
stages.whoA: Her brother-in-law, in prison.
stages.whoB: His sister-in-law, who looks after his son.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Peter saves Nico from an alien on his first day of school, and she becomes his best friend. Learning his secret from Harry hurts her, but she forgives him after seeing him save lives.
stages.whoA: His best friend, Nico.
stages.whoB: Her best friend, secretly Spider-Man.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Spider-Man saves Harry from thugs, and Harry learns Peter's secret and guides him from Oscorp. He has a new red and blue suit made for Peter, and they stay friends after Peter cuts ties with Oscorp.
stages.whoA: Harry, his friend and guide at Oscorp.
stages.whoB: Peter, the friend he backs as Spider-Man.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Harry befriends Nico, Peter's best friend, and she learns Peter's secret from him.
stages.whoA: Nico, Peter's best friend and his new friend.
stages.whoB: Harry, a new friend who tells her Peter's secret.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Norman is Harry's father and the head of Oscorp. When Spider-Man saves Harry, Norman sets out to find the hero to thank him.
stages.whoA: His son, Harry.
stages.whoB: His father, Oscorp's CEO.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Norman makes Peter an Oscorp intern, uncovers his secret and mentors Spider-Man from his office, and his glider saves Peter from the Scorpion. After Norman opens a space gateway despite Strange's warning, Peter cuts ties with Oscorp.
stages.whoA: Peter, his intern, secretly the Spider-Man he mentors.
stages.whoB: Norman Osborn, his mentor at Oscorp.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: James Sanders and Maria Vasquez rob a jewelry store together with high tech gear, until Spider-Man trips Speed Demon into her and webs them both.
stages.whoA: Maria, his partner in crime.
stages.whoB: James, her partner in crime.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Coached by Norman, Spider-Man takes down Speed Demon, a crook with super speed boots.
stages.whoA: Speed Demon, a crook he takes down.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who takes him down.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Coached by Norman over the police scanner, Spider-Man takes down Maria Vasquez, a crook with energy blade gauntlets, during a jewelry store robbery.
stages.whoA: Maria Vasquez, a crook he takes down.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who takes her down.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Otto Octavius was one of Oscorp's top scientists, until he fell out with Norman and quit, taking designs with him. Norman's tip helps Secretary Ross arrest him, and when Norman gloats over his deal for Otto's inventions, Otto vows to get him.
stages.whoA: Otto, his former scientist, whom he gets arrested.
stages.whoB: Norman, his old boss, who gets him arrested and takes his tech.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Iron Man helps Secretary Ross arrest Otto for breaking the Sokovia Accords.
stages.whoA: Iron Man, who helps arrest him.
stages.whoB: Otto, whom he helps arrest.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Otto secretly arms New York's criminals with advanced tech, turning them into super villains, and Spider-Man helps Norman track him down.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who helps track him down.
stages.whoB: Otto, who arms the villains he fights.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Otto builds the battle suit that turns Mac Gargan into the Scorpion.
stages.whoA: Gargan, whom he arms with the Scorpion suit.
stages.whoB: Otto, who builds his suit.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Otto sells Mila Masaryk the laser helmet she uses as the Unicorn.
stages.whoA: Mila, a crook he sells a laser helmet.
stages.whoB: Otto, who sells her the Unicorn helmet.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Mila and Mikhail are partners in a robbery crew. After the others are caught, Mila uses her new helmet to break them out of prison.
stages.whoA: Mikhail, her partner in the crew.
stages.whoB: Mila, his partner, who breaks him out.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: The Unicorn uses Mikhail as bait, but after Spider-Man saves him, Mikhail takes her helmet and the police arrest them both.
stages.whoA: Mikhail, her partner, who takes her helmet.
stages.whoB: Mila, who used him as bait.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Dmitri is part of Mila's robbery crew. After the others are caught, she breaks him out of prison as the Unicorn, and he flees.
stages.whoA: Dmitri, a member of her crew she breaks out.
stages.whoB: Mila, who breaks him out of prison.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: The Unicorn breaks her crew out of prison and fights Spider-Man, until her partner takes her helmet and the police arrest her.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who stops her.
stages.whoB: The Unicorn, a crook with a laser helmet.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Mikhail is part of the robbery crew Spider-Man chases, and the police catch him. When the Unicorn breaks him out, he faces Spider-Man again.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who tries to stop the crew.
stages.whoB: Mikhail, one of the Unicorn's crew.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: When the Unicorn turns her laser on Mikhail, Spider-Man takes the blast to save him. Mikhail pulls off her helmet to repay the debt, and both crooks are arrested.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who saves his life.
stages.whoB: Mikhail, who turns on the Unicorn to repay him.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Dmitri is one of the robbers Spider-Man chases, and the police catch him while Spider-Man saves people from the blaze. After the Unicorn breaks him out of prison, he flees.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who chases his crew.
stages.whoB: Dmitri, one of the Unicorn's crew.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Butane burns down a building to clear space for a high-rise. Spider-Man beats him and finds a strange symbol on his gear.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who beats him.
stages.whoB: Butane, an arsonist he beats.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: In Otto's suit, Mac Gargan becomes the Scorpion and nearly kills Spider-Man, until Norman's glider saves him. In their rematch Spider-Man nearly kills Gargan before Lonnie stops him.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who nearly kills him in their rematch.
stages.whoB: The Scorpion, who nearly kills him.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Gargan leads the Scorpions against the 110th Street Gang and stabs Lonnie when he shields Big Donovan. Lonnie later fights him beside Spider-Man, then stops Spider-Man from killing him.
stages.whoA: Lonnie, a rival gangster who stands against him.
stages.whoB: Gargan, the rival gang boss who stabbed him.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Lonnie joins Big Donovan's 110th Street Gang in place of his younger brother Andre. After he saves Donovan's life in a fight with the Scorpions, the gang starts calling him Tombstone. When Gargan nearly kills Donovan, Donovan quits and flees, leaving Lonnie to lead the gang.
stages.whoA: Lonnie, the recruit who saves his life.
stages.whoB: Big Donovan, the gang boss who abandons him.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Lonnie is Peter's good friend and lab partner, a football star who joins a gang to protect his younger brother. In the end he fights the Scorpion beside Spider-Man and stops him from killing Gargan.
stages.whoA: Peter, his friend and lab partner.
stages.whoB: Lonnie, his friend and lab partner.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Pearl is Lonnie's girlfriend. She confronts him at his gang's hideout, and after Spider-Man saves her, she breaks up with him.
stages.whoA: Pearl, his girlfriend, until she leaves him over the gang.
stages.whoB: Lonnie, her boyfriend, until she breaks up with him.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Gargan's Scorpions are at war with Big Donovan's 110th Street Gang. Gargan nearly kills Donovan, who begs for mercy, quits and flees.
stages.whoA: Big Donovan, the rival gang boss he nearly kills.
stages.whoB: Gargan, the rival gang boss who nearly kills him.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Big Donovan's 110th Street Gang ambushes a police convoy carrying Otto's tech, and Spider-Man steps in. He still saves Donovan from the Scorpion, then lets the gang go with a warning.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who stops his gang but saves his life.
stages.whoB: Big Donovan, boss of the 110th Street Gang.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Pearl babysat Peter until he was twelve, and she is his childhood crush. They reunite at Bales High, and Spider-Man saves her at Lonnie's gang hideout.
stages.whoA: Peter, the boy she used to babysit.
stages.whoB: Pearl, his old babysitter and childhood crush.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Doctor Strange fights an alien at Midtown High on Peter's first day, and a spider from his portal bites Peter. Later Peter helps Strange send the alien back and close Norman's gateway, and the two become friends.
stages.whoA: Doctor Strange, the sorcerer he helps close Norman's gateway.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a young hero he befriends.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Strange warns Norman that his space gateway will unleash horrors, but Norman blames him for wrecking Midtown High and has his guards blast him. When an alien comes through, Strange still saves Norman's life.
stages.whoA: Norman, who ignores his warning and has him blasted.
stages.whoB: A sorcerer who warns him off his gateway.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Daredevil breaks into Oscorp, sure Norman is hiding something, and knocks Spider-Man out. He also warns Peter about Norman.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, whom he knocks out at Oscorp.
stages.whoB: Daredevil, who beats him and warns him about Norman.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Jeanne is Daredevil's partner, the hero Finesse. She works undercover as an Oscorp intern to spy on Norman and Harry for him.
stages.whoA: Finesse, his partner, undercover at Oscorp.
stages.whoB: Daredevil, her partner, who sends her to spy on Oscorp.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Dr. Carla Connors supervises Peter's intern project in Oscorp's energy division, and together they build a working Magnetic Generator. She defends him against Bentley Wittman's criticism and covers for him when he slips away.
stages.whoA: Peter, the intern she supervises.
stages.whoB: Dr. Connors, his supervisor at Oscorp, who believes in him.

stages.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
stages.text: Carla Connors is a scientist in Oscorp's energy division. When Norman reveals that the interns' work has secretly built his space gateway, she argues against it.
stages.whoA: Norman, her boss at Oscorp.
stages.whoB: Carla, one of his scientists.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: As the Prowler, Aaron fights Spider-Man beside the Green Goblin when Peter tries to shut down Kingpin's collider.
stages.whoA: The Prowler, Kingpin's enforcer, who fights him at the collider.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whom he fights at Kingpin's collider.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
